label: hAP ac lite
description: MikroTik hAP ac lite (RB952Ui-5ac2nD) — 5x 100M RJ45, Wi-Fi 2.4 GHz + 5 GHz. MIPSBE 1-core QCA9531.
notes: Inlet is eth1, outlet eth5. https://manual.mikrotik.com/hardware/hap-ac-lite/ (read 2026-11-28): "The device accepts power from the power jack or from the first Ethernet port (Passive PoE) ... The Ether5 port supports PoE output for powering other RouterBOARD devices ... up to 0.58A". https://mikrotik.com/product/RB952Ui-5ac2nD: PoE in Passive PoE, PoE in input Voltage 10-28 V, PoE-out ports Ether5, PoE out Passive PoE, PoE-Out current limit 500 mA, Max power consumption 20 W, Max power consumption without attachments 8 W. The inlet asks for 8 W, not the 12.95 W an 802.3af guess assumed: this is passive PoE and the board publishes no class. eth2-eth4 are poeIn: false; eth5 sources but cannot be fed.
